glossary.definition: (1) "Claim" means any attempt to cause a health care insurer to make payment of a health care benefit.
glossary.source_title: Section 3999.22 - Health insurance referrals - prohibited activities - exceptions.

glossary.definition: (2) "Health care benefit" means the right under a contract or a certificate or policy of insurance to have a payment made by a health care insurer for a specified health care service.
glossary.source_title: Section 3999.22 - Health insurance referrals - prohibited activities - exceptions.
